subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: The direct inbound parser gap is source-proven, but exposing full card/action data changes Feishu channel message semantics and must preserve existing simple button command behavior.

options.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, reuse the existing card parser for direct inbound messages, and let the card-action and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Narrow to direct inbound text
options.body: Limit this issue to message_type interactive text extraction and leave callback fields and merge_forward behavior entirely to their existing linked issues.

options.title: Define full payload contract first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers decide whether agents should receive text extraction only or fuller card/form payload envelopes.

recommendation.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, reuse the existing card parser for direct inbound messages, and let the card-action and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is Feishu plugin message-contract direction, and the plugin metadata names m1heng as the community-maintained Feishu/Lark contact.
